title: Privacy Policy
body:
Cambridge Hospital is committed to protecting the privacy and confidentiality of your personal information.

Personal information provided through this website, including the Contact Us and Book an Appointment forms, will be collected and processed only for the purposes for which it is provided, such as responding to your inquiry, processing your appointment request, and providing relevant healthcare services.

By submitting your information, you acknowledge that you have read this Privacy Notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for the stated purposes.

You have the right to withdraw or modify your consent at any time, subject to applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Withdrawal of consent will not affect the lawfulness of any processing carried out prior to the withdrawal.

If you wish to withdraw or modify your consent, access or correct your personal information, or exercise your applicable data subject rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@cambridgehospital.ae.

Your personal information will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable UAE data protection requirements and the Abu Dhabi Healthcare Information and Cyber Security Standard (ADHICS).
